name: masturbodeploy
description: Creates the release branch, bumps the version, and handles merge and deploy for workspace repositories
author: Giovanni Belfiore

scripts.install-local: npm run compile && rm -rf "$HOME/.cursor/extensions/giovanni-belfiore.masturbodeploy-0.1.0" "$HOME/.cursor/extensions/local.release-deploy-0.1.0" && mkdir -p "$HOME/.vscode/extensions/giovanni-belfiore.masturbodeploy-0.1.0" && cp package.json README.md "$HOME/.vscode/extensions/giovanni-belfiore.masturbodeploy-0.1.0/" && rm -rf "$HOME/.vscode/extensions/giovanni-belfiore.masturbodeploy-0.1.0/out" "$HOME/.vscode/extensions/giovanni-belfiore.masturbodeploy-0.1.0/media" && cp -R out media "$HOME/.vscode/extensions/giovanni-belfiore.masturbodeploy-0.1.0/"
